name: bswrwa-signup-form-drift
goal: If entering the account identity changes the reviewed signup form, refuse before saving a generated password.

evidence: An identity input handler changes the reviewed signup POST destination before any secret is filled. The scoped Keychain entry must remain absent and the browser must be destroyed.

The existing signed CLI signup scenario asserted success, Keychain presence and cleanup. Its new changed-form state uses the same broker, Keychain and Chromium with a site that replaces the reviewed action when the executor fills the identity.
Recorded on MB2 at 2f1eee14b4. The exact packaged signup returned failed, while the Keychain-absence assertion reproduced the stale entry.
Complete identity entry and recheck the signed form during browser preparation. Check again immediately before filling the persisted password.
Recorded on MB2 at f035f752b9 with the unchanged assertion and command. The changed form returned failed, Keychain remained empty, and the browser journal was empty after teardown.

Eight packaged browser and native software-approval E2Es passed on MB2 at f035f752b9. The focused process took 39.54 seconds with 209666048 bytes maximum RSS. Thirty-five focused unit tests, typecheck, changed-file lint, Harness audit and unit registry passed. The tests used a disposable synthetic Keychain and browser. Evidence contains no screenshots.
